<div class="card-body">
'''Jawa''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ジャワ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊敵味方のフォースデッキから、１フォースずつ消費して、配備する。さもなければ、配備できない。タトゥイーンにのみ配備する。他の星系へ移動することはできる。</span><ref name="jp1-face">Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-12o-Video.jpg|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Jawa (Light) (Premiere) (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text.</ref>
<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Jawa-Light-C1G.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">口数の多い屑拾い種族。身長１メートル。ジャワ同士で交わす言語は理解不能だが、本当は人間の言葉も話すことができる。巨大な石の砦を築くこともある。</span>''<ref name="jp1-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Jawa.

'''Card text:''' * To deploy, use 1 Force from each player's Force Pile. Cannot deploy otherwise. Deploy only on Tatooine. May move to other systems.

'''Lore:''' A talkative scavenger species. One meter tall. Their own language is unintelligible, but they can speak human languages when they want to. They sometimes build huge stone forts.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Jawa (Light) (Premiere)]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
